BARDEEN: Physicist who won the Nobel Prize twice (transistor and superconductivity).
CURIE: Only person to win Nobel Prizes in two different sciences (Physics & Chemistry).
DYNAMITE: Alfred Nobel’s invention whose commercial success funded the Nobel Prizes.
MALALA: Youngest Nobel Prize laureate ever (Peace Prize, age 17).
PEACE: Nobel Prize category awarded in Oslo instead of Stockholm.
TAGORE: First Asian to receive the Nobel Prize in Literature.

EINSTEIN: Scientist awarded the Nobel Prize for the photoelectric effect.
MATHEMATICS: Subject for which no Nobel Prize exists.
PAULING: Only person to receive two unshared Nobel Prizes.
RAMAN: First scientist from India to be awarded a Nobel Prize in a scientific category.
REDCROSS: Organization awarded the Nobel Peace Prize three times.
